title: Final stacking raid farm update
summary: The stacking raid farm received a major final revision with redstone, timing and reliability improvements.
description: The farm was reworked to address vexes, timing problems, mob fall damage and other reliability issues.

body.text: Farm timings, settings and the redstone system were changed to improve reliability and reduce problems with vexes.
The revised tutorial explained the new redstone tower, system changes and updated farm timings.
